sources.title: York County 2026 General Primary results (Clarity Elections, linked from the county's Previous Election Results page); precinct detail XML last updated 6/11/2026
York County 2026 General Primary detailed results XML (all contests, by precinct)
York County Previous Election Results page (links to the Clarity results)
Summary CSV export of the official results, used for holder names (summary.zip, generated 2026-06-11)

notes: York County Republican committee is elected in gubernatorial-year primaries: each of 161 precincts has a '<precinct> Republican Committeeperson 4 Year Term' contest, vote for 2, so seats are labelled Committeeperson 1-2. The results list named write-in recipients separately from ballot candidates (ballot candidates carry a party code). Each precinct's 2 seats were filled in order of votes: a ballot candidate with votes in the top 2 = filled; a top-2 place held by a named write-in = unknown (named write-in winners stay unknown because acceptance isn't public); a tie across the cutoff = unknown; leftover seats = unknown if any write-in votes were cast, else empty. Many unknown seats are 2-way or multi-way ties among write-ins with 1 vote each. The Clarity site does not say whether the data is the certified version, but its last update (June 11, 2026) is after the county's certification period. Precinct names are taken from the contest titles with the office text removed. Appointments since the primary are not captured. Holder names come from the Summary CSV export: on each seat already counted as filled, the winning ballot candidate as printed (named write-ins are never used).
